people.name: Laban
people.line: Brother of Rebekah; father of Leah and Rachel

translations.web: Laban said to him, “Surely you are my bone and my flesh.” Jacob stayed with him for a month.
translations.bsb: Then Laban declared, “You are indeed my own flesh and blood.” After Jacob had stayed with him a month,
translations.kjv: And Laban said to him, Surely thou art my bone and my flesh. And he abode with him the space of a month.
translations.asv: And Laban said to him, Surely thou art my bone and my flesh. And he abode with him the space of a month.
